text: Appeal of Order to Comply (February 14, 2018) for 313 Manor Road East.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated February 14, 2018, regarding the property located at 313 Manor Road East, Folder No. 18 117243 PRS 00 IV,and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 29, 2018.
